sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 420. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies Beguilement for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 30 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 100 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
